# V-JEPA2 Encoder Source

This is the small, unchanged encoder-source subset used by RoboDemo's
evaluated temporal encoder. It contains no model weights or RoboDemo
training implementation.

Upstream: https://github.com/facebookresearch/vjepa2

The original Meta copyright headers and MIT license are retained.
Obtain the original-format `vjepa2-ac-vitg.pt` checkpoint through
`scripts/prepare_assets.py`. Other upstream models and checkpoints are not
interchangeable with this encoder.
